diagnosis.original_evidence: PlanVisibleCenteredContent limits visibleAspect to 0.5..5, even though this is a partial captured optical fragment rather than a complete window source aspect.
source_trace: Original 3440x1440 game 4:3 visible rectangle is centred within the full game client while the desktop capture samples only output intersection.
Client shifted left 2300px yields 380x1440 valid part whose sampled visibleAspect is 0.264, previously causing an invalid CropPlan return.
R23 uses the plan to crop UV and preserve original 4:3 optical quad size with visibleScale and offset in the shared two-eye projection; invalid plans keep incorrectly sampled client aspect.
diagnosis.root_cause: A full-client source aspect validation threshold was applied to a post-intersection fragment, which can be arbitrarily thin or tall but physically valid.
alternatives_rejected: The XR FOV tangent averaging and common stereo clip are already aspect-correct for valid plans; the error occurs before either eye render, not at SkyGlow or F11.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Remove inappropriate clipped-fragment aspect bounds but still reject nonfinite/zero dimensions; authored content scale/offset and UV intersection logic remain unchanged.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Native C++ smoke covers 380x1440 horizontal and 2496x230 vertical surviving fragments plus stale UV negative controls, and retains original full/asymmetric scenarios.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only the two-eye LOCAL-fixed menu path consumes the corrected crop/optical plan; game world/HUD and separate mono theater and SBS paths are not modified.

runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR hardware test performed. Build and source-only validation do not prove live binocular imagery.
